style_en: Vertical 9:16 miniature diorama 3D CG render in an empty white space. Smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details), told apart by clothing and hairstyle. Soft shadows, slightly high angle. Mostly white and gray, only key objects red. Keep the top 35% of the frame empty with no heads or objects; place the main subject between 35% and 68% of the height, centered. The robbers' helicopter is always the same small light helicopter with a white body, a gray belly and a red side stripe, no registration letters, no markings. Police helicopters are always plain dark blue with no markings. Police officers always wear plain dark navy uniforms with no insignia. The black bag is always the same plain black duffel bag with no text. All set in 2009; no extra props from other eras, no year plaque, no caption plate.
avoid_en: logos, brand names, readable text or numbers, flags, police insignia, registration letters on aircraft, blood, wounds, guns, explosions, fire, faces resembling real people, year plaques

police.desc_en: police officers, figurines with smooth featureless faces in plain dark navy uniforms and plain navy caps with no insignia, no badges and no text
